text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Espoir City suddenly announced she wanted to go to the Umadol Sports Festival.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's going on right around here.
...Well, figured it might kill some time, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*...
...Sheesh, that Falco...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Haaaah?! A cheer-off between fan clubs?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A cheering battle with everyone from the stands!
We'll compete to see whose fans are the most passionate!
We want you to help hype it up too, Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why me?
It's not like I'm a fan of yours to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Because, because! Your voice is so powerful, and your confident aura is so cool! As long as Espo-san is here, I don't feel like we'd lose in any competition!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As long as Falco's fighting as an umadol, I refuse to lose to anyone...! So please! Lend me your strength, Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaargh, DAMMIIIIT!!

Led by Espoir City, we arrived at the venue,
which was buzzing with palpable excitement.
A series of thrilling competitions followed—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, for today's special event!
Let's kick off a cheering contest
between our fans~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Who gives a crap about the details.
You just follow my lead and shout with everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, keep going! Put your life on the line
so the other fans don't look down on us!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Knock 'em dead!! FAL-COOOOO-!!!!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text:
—That Umamusume is on fire...!
—Damn it, I gotta show my love for my favorite with everything I've got!!
—Just watch, I'm definitely not losing!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What if she front-ruuuuns!!??

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: We've got no choice but to chaaaase after them!!" Oakley

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!! Falco is super touched~~!
Thank you so much, everyone~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Man, what a storm of cheers!
Falco-san's fans in particular brought insane energy!
And the one shining brightest as the MVP is—!"

The jumbotron briefly went dark.
A drumroll echoed—and the next moment,
what appeared across the entire screen was...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Ah... y-yeah..."

With the cheer battle concluded, the Umadols'
competitions resumed. However...
(WAAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
......
......I'll be right back.

Sensing something was off, I leave my seat to follow her.
Espoir City was catching her breath all alone
in a corner of the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Tch, you've gotta be kidding me...! Flashing things on screen out of nowhere, making loud noises..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah, damn it...! And why's my heart... still beating this fast?!

text_block_list.name: Cheers from the Venue
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it.

Espoir City stiffens at the cheers.
It seems she was startled by the sheer volume and being shown
on the big screen, making her nervous.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gah!! Y-You bastard...!
I told you I'd be right back, damn it...!
choice_data_list: Still, you seemed to be having such a rough time...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~!? Hey, you!
Don't you dare talk down to me!!
choice_data_list: The sound's so loud it looks rough on you, so maybe you should head home for today...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tough?! Not in the sliiightest!!
Besides, the tournament ain't even over yet!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Going home early when someone's still out there fighting...?
—Like hell I'd ever pull something that lame...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm here, I'm seeing this through!
Get back there right now—...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm cheerin' for ya, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
ORAAAAAHH!!!!
Fire yourself up, Fa-l-co!!!!

Espoir City kept up her passionate yelling
until the very end. And then—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, thank you so so much~~~!!
When I heard your voice, Espo-san,
Falco was so incredibly happy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to try my absolute hardest♪
Winning first place is all thanks to you, Espo-san~~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It was a real hassle for me, you know.
...Well, as long as you were able to do your best, I guess it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, but you weren't in your seat for a bit, right? I was a little worried something had happened.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Ah—... nah, that ain't it...
I mean, how do I put it...
choice_data_list: You just got shy after being chosen as the MVP, didn't you?
Thanks for keeping me company on my break!
You kept me company on my break!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Ah—... nah, that ain't it...
I mean, how do I put it...
choice_data_list: You just got shy after being chosen as the MVP, didn't you?
Thanks for keeping me company on my break!
You kept me company on my break!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is that right!? You don't have to be shy about it~~!
Back then, you really stood out and looked so cool, Espo-san~!
choice_data_list: Which is exactly why you're the MVP!
Which is exactly why you're the MVP!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, you punks!
Don't go getting all full of yourselves, hey!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. She just wouldn't shut up about it,
so I had no choice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, really~!?
Espo-san, you're so sweet~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...It's not like I'm trying to be nice or anything...
